rows.text: I was seen within twenty minutes of walking into emergency, and the doctor explained every step in Bangla before anything was signed.
rows.name: Anjali Das

rows.text: My father spent eleven days in the ICU. Somebody from the team called us with an update every single evening, unprompted.
rows.name: Rakesh Sarkar

rows.text: The maternity block staff stayed past their shift until my daughter was born. I have never been treated like that in a hospital.
rows.name: Farida Begum

rows.text: Knee replacement in March, walking unaided by May. The physio team called every week to check I was doing the exercises.
rows.name: Prabir Ghosh

rows.text: Billing desk came to the bed rather than making us queue downstairs. Small thing, but it mattered that day.
rows.name: Nasreen Khatun

rows.text: Waited over an hour past my appointment slot in the eye clinic. Staff were apologetic but nobody told me until I asked.
rows.name: Sujoy Mondal
